The anglerfishs own vocabulary — nine parts, the size of the mosasaurs and the krakens. It draws the general pool as well (ownNames is blank in bosses.csv) because this animal genuinely does swim and hunt, so the pools swimming words are not a lie about it. These only add what the pool cannot say: that it carries a LIGHT, and that it is a thing from the bottom. Note there is no word here for speed or for chasing — the pool has plenty and they would all be wrong about a boss whose whole proposition is that it waits.
